title: An irreducible polynomial quotient over a field is a field
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $p\in F[T]$ a polynomial [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Assume that $p$ is irreducible: it is nonzero, is not a unit, and in every factorization $p=gh$ one of $g,h$ is a unit. Then $F[T]/(p)$, where $(p)$ is the ideal of multiples of $p$, is a field with its natural $F$-algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient].
